note: Index of every content file the engine loads. The engine resolves nothing by hard-coded path except this manifest.
title: content/ui/title.json
speechColoursNote: A colour per speaker for spoken lines. Hand-authored, and NOT in the extracted speakers table: that file is rewritten whole on every extraction, so a colour edited there would vanish silently at the next run.
assayNote: Doc 03's Liar's Assay: the pairs, their wrong answers and the duels, extracted by tools/extract-content.mjs. Read by the dialogue runner when an option names a duel.
overlaysNote: A head composited over a body that never swaps -- doc 43 part two's draw order step 4. Named here like every other record: an overlay discovered from a directory is an overlay nobody chose.
carriedLightNote: Errata D8's lantern pool. Named here rather than discovered, like every other record. The file was fully specified and referenced by nothing for as long as it went unnamed -- R5l -- and naming it is what gives it a reader.
pathsNote: Traced walk paths. Named here like every other record, and keyed by this path rather than by an id inside the file -- the trace is authored by hand against the plate and the loader's convenience does not belong in it.
actorsNote: EXPLICIT, AS RULED, and not convention discovery from content/actors/*.json. A directory listing silently picks up whatever happens to be on disk -- a half-written record, something copied in to look at -- and then the game loads it or does not depending on somebody's afternoon. A list is checkable, and check-asset-paths already earned that argument by failing loudly on a path nobody declared. `actor` below stays: it names which of these is the protagonist, which is a different fact from which records exist.

musicNote:
DOC 45'S BEDS. `title` is O-01-M -- CONSOLATION, the title mix. `stage_road` is O-02-M -- THADDEUS, Room 1, four bars of 3/4 solo and unaccompanied. Both are named here and rendered by tools/render-music.mjs from the proof's own synthesis, which is errata 49 item 1.

THE FILES DO NOT EXIST UNTIL SOMEBODY RUNS THE RENDERER, and it has never been run: it needs Chromium and it was written where none could be installed. Music.ts treats a missing file as silence rather than an error, so the game runs exactly as it does today and the moment the stems are committed it plays. Nothing else has to change.

WAV rather than OGG because the renderer writes PCM directly and encoding to Ogg needs a codec the repo does not carry. Converting later is one ffmpeg pass and one edit here; shipping a wrong extension that nothing can decode is worse.

GAINS: the title is the loudest thing in the game and Room 1 is a man alone at night, so the bed sits under him. Both are look decisions and both are one number in a content file.

`listening_chamber` is R33-M -- THADDEUS, complete (errata 70 C): the same four bars with the fourth resolved to the tonic, composed by the builder at Tyler's word (2026-11-06, errata 99 L) and rendered from the proof's THADDEUS_COMPLETE_LA. A placeholder like every theme in the score. It is baked at -35 cents like the others; `tunedFlag` and the ninety seconds bring it to pitch.

ERRATA 103: THE ROOM MIXES. Every room doc 28 Part Three names now has its bed, each entry carrying its reason in `why`. `null` is deliberate silence (the undertaker's); a room with no entry plays the title bed until doc 28 or Tyler gives it one. A bed's `layers` loop on their own lengths, never re-synced; `variants` swap the bed on a flag, first match wins (the Nugget piano after T_NUGGET_PIANO_TUNED).
actedDirectionsNote: Doc 95 (errata 141): which shown stage directions a figure acts, extracted from the document. The loader gives each A row to the figures it names as `sprite.performs`.
